business_summary: Shenzhen Sea Star Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the smart hardware manufacturing, research and development, production, and sales of smart terminal products in China. The company offers engineering testing, manufacturing, and supply chain management services for industrial-grade equipment and related products; semiconductor packaging equipment components, automotive electronics, and other services. It also engaged in the design, research and development, production and sales of LED smart lighting and related supporting smart terminal products, as well as provides LED solutions. The company was formerly known as Shen Zhen Mindata Holding Co., Ltd and changed its name to Shenzhen Sea Star Technology Co.,Ltd in March 2021. Shenzhen Sea Star Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
